preregistered.written_before: the sentence was interpreted, the programme resolved, the site searched, the section chosen, anything built or read
preregistered.model: no API key and no retrieval provider are configured; the terminal agent answers every staged job. Research REPLAYED from fixtures/closure-city/evidence and disclosed; any new retrieval is recorded in sources/INDEX.md with its URL, access date and the exact claim it supports.

must_demonstrate: two adjoining districts whose fabric contrasts -- different house type, lot grain and storey band -- with the boundary between them in the section
one monumental boundary and the transition through it: the wall, its gate, and the ground on both sides of the passage
courtyard dwelling function verified on the built blocks: court, gate and enclosing range in the intended relationship
market function verified on the built blocks: usable stalls, a clear aisle and a way in from the street
one connected circulation network across every part of the section, from the outermost gate in the section to the innermost part of it
section_extent.reported_not_targeted: the number of parts the section comes to, its columns, and its build time

expectations.architecture_not_labels: every functional claim about the section rests on a final-world predicate run on the assembled world after all construction; a FUNCTION label, an occupied bounding box or a generator assertion establishes nothing, and an unsupported predicate is reported unresolved rather than satisfied
expectations.references: the judge cites claims this run actually made from retrieved sources; a form claimed beyond what a source says is recorded as a design decision in the type's own docstring and in sources/INDEX.md, not as a sourced fact
expectations.honest_scope: clauses about parts outside the section are `unobserved` and hold nothing; clauses measured on the plan are `plan` evidence however much of the section stood; whole-city identity is not claimed and the read fails on it as registered
expectations.outcome: a built, checked, inspected connected section demonstrating the five relationships above with section-level fidelity stated, or a stop naming which relationship could not be demonstrated and why
